## Outcome
Create and reconcile Orcastrata-managed GitHub issues without duplicates.

## Scope
Read:
- T040 projection receipt
- Exact repository issue state
- Verified local gh identity and permission

Write:
- plugins/codexmax-orchestrator/scripts/github_issue_effect.py
- plugins/codexmax-orchestrator/scripts/github_issue_live.py
- plugins/codexmax-orchestrator/assets/contracts/github-issue-effect-v1.md
- tests/test_github_issue_effect.py
- tests/test_github_issue_live.py
- Orcastrata-managed issues in github.com/Vel-Labs/orcastrata-max

## Non-goals
- Pull requests
- Merge
- Schedules
- AOL

## Acceptance criteria
- Prepare, observe, create, and reconcile behavior prevents duplicates and resolves unknown outcomes.

## Validation
- `VAL-T050` — Run fake-gh faults, consumers, release parity, independent audit, and an idempotent exact-repository canary. → All selected checks pass.

## Dependencies
- T040

## Stop condition
Stop on identity or permission failure, multiple marker matches, transport drift, or an unreconciled unknown effect.

## Orcastrata state
- Work item: `T050`
- GoalBuddy status: `active`
